work_completed: CodeRabbit review of PR 107, three findings fixed. All three left an avatar or an anchor stuck.
Governance denial now calls AvatarCharacter.Halt(), which ends any interaction before holding still. Before, a chair reserved by the interaction it replaced stayed occupied for good.
AvatarCharacter._ExitTree ends any interaction, so an avatar removed by SyncLiveAvatars frees the anchor it held.

Main.RunTransit's finally releases an avatar still held for the transition, so a failure the catch does not expect cannot leave it frozen (ingress rejects every intent while it is held). A successful placement has already cleared the hold, so that path is unchanged.
decisions_made: A governance denial still stops the avatar (IdleController) as before; it now also frees what it held rather than preserving the interaction.
